name: prism-ts
description: Monorepo for Prism - The language where AI meets certainty

scripts.release: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/core --filter=@prism-lang/validator --filter=@prism-lang/llm --filter=@prism-lang/cli --filter=@prism-lang/repl --filter=@prism-lang/confidence && changeset publish
scripts.release:publish: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@prism-lang/core --filter=@prism-lang/validator --filter=@prism-lang/llm --filter=@prism-lang/cli --filter=@prism-lang/repl --filter=@prism-lang/confidence && changeset publish && git push --follow-tags
